transcript:
**Agent:** Good morning! Thank you for calling TechSolutions SaaS. This is Sarah. How can I assist you today?

**Customer:** Hi Sarah, I hope you can help me. I’m having issues with my billing. I was charged twice this month for the Pro plan.

**Agent:** I’m sorry to hear that! Let me take a look at your account to understand what happened. Can you please provide me with your email associated with the account?

**Customer:** Sure, it’s john.doe@example.com.

**Agent:** Thank you, John. One moment while I pull up your information. (pause) Okay, I see the issue. It looks like there was a glitch in our system that caused a duplicate charge. 

**Customer:** That's frustrating. Will I get a refund for the extra charge?

**Agent:** Absolutely! I can process a refund for you right now. It will take around 3-5 business days to reflect back in your account.

**Customer:** That’s good to know. Can I also change my billing cycle? I’d prefer monthly instead of annually.

**Agent:** Yes, we can certainly change that for you. I’ll adjust your billing cycle to monthly starting next month. 

**Customer:** Great! Thanks for your help. By the way, are there any new features in the Pro plan that I should know about?

**Agent:** Yes! We recently added an advanced analytics dashboard and increased storage capacity. It’s a great way to enhance your user experience!

**Customer:** That sounds useful! Maybe I’ll consider upgrading my plan later.

**Agent:** Absolutely! I’d be happy to assist you with that if you decide to upgrade. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

**Customer:** No, that’s all! Thank you for clearing up my issues.

**Agent:** You’re welcome, John! I’m glad I could help. Don’t hesitate to reach out if you have any more questions. Have a wonderful day! 

**Customer:** Thanks, Sarah! You too!
